name: gizza-ai/extract-substring
summary: Extract a portion of text by index or between delimiters

tool.description: Pull out a portion of text. mode='index' returns the substring from a 0-based start character (inclusive) to an end character (exclusive); both may be negative to count from the end, and end may be omitted for the rest of the string (indices are character-based and clamped). mode='delimiters' returns every non-overlapping substring found between a start_delim and end_delim. Runs locally.

text.description: The source text to extract from.

mode.description: How to extract: 'index' (by character position) or 'delimiters' (everything between two markers).

start.description: index mode: 0-based start character (inclusive). Negative counts from the end. Default 0.

end.description: index mode: end character (exclusive). Negative counts from the end. Omit for end-of-string.

start_delim.description: delimiters mode: the opening delimiter (required in delimiters mode).

end_delim.description: delimiters mode: the closing delimiter (required in delimiters mode).
